title: Stochastic Modeling of the Mean Time Between Software Failures: A review
abstract: arXiv:2611.21619v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: A review of several models for the software failure detection stochastic process is per- formed. We focus on how the Mean Time Between Failures is obtained from those models and present a comparative study. The models considered involve some of the well known based on non- homogeneous Poisson processes and a recently proposed model based on contagion. Our main target is to evaluate the models performance when they are applied to modern software projects developed under Agile methodologies. Recently developed Software Engineering practices (TDD, Scrum, etc.), propose an iterative procedure be- tween development, testing and debugging, introducing this way, particular challenges to Software Reliability modeling. As opposed to the non-homogeneous Poisson processes, the failure rate of the contagion model depends not just on time but also on the number of previously detected failures. translated_title: 软件故障间平均时间的随机建模：综述
translated_abstract: 本文对软件故障检测随机过程的若干模型进行了综述。我们重点关注如何从这些模型中推导出故障间平均时间（MTBF），并给出了一项比较研究。所考虑的模型包括一些广为人知的基于非齐次泊松过程的模型，以及近期提出的一种基于传染机制的模型。我们的主要目标是评估这些模型在应用于采用敏捷方法论开发的现代软件项目时的性能。近年来发展起来的软件工程实践（如TDD、Scrum等）提出了开发、测试与调试之间的迭代流程，这给软件可靠性建模带来了特殊的挑战。与非齐次泊松过程不同，传染模型的故障率不仅取决于时间，还取决于先前已检测到的故障数量。所有被考虑的模型均为非齐次……（原文此处被截断）的特例。
tldr: 本文综述并比较了基于非齐次泊松过程与传染机制的软件故障检测随机模型中故障间平均时间（MTBF）的推导方法，评估其在敏捷开发方法下的适用性，其中传染模型的故障率同时依赖于时间与已检测到的故障数量。
en_tdlr: This review compares stochastic models for software failure detection based on non-homogeneous Poisson processes and a contagion-based model, evaluating how the Mean Time Between Failures is derived and their applicability to modern Agile software projects, where the contagion model's failure rate depends on both time and the number of previously detected failures.
